research_question: How much of frozen S2 candidate construction can be externalized as deterministic retrieval over an explicit candidate ontology before invoking an LLM for residual novelty?

predictor.normalization: lowercase; underscore/hyphen to spaces; ASCII alphanumeric tokenization; fixed generic English stopwords
predictor.query_expansion: selected fact/concept/relation/goal semantic strings plus semantic dictionary entries whose IDs are explicitly referenced by the selected relation string
predictor.token_score: TF-IDF cosine over candidate documents; IDF=log((N+1)/(df+1))+1
predictor.char_score: character trigram frequency cosine over normalized strings
predictor.emission: top 3 unique candidate IDs as an unordered set

claim_limits: This does not claim current EC natively generates candidates.
Failure does not prove deterministic candidate generation is impossible.
Success only establishes externalizability when the candidate ontology is explicit and visible.
No result authorizes automatic Qwen3-4B escalation.
